remarks: Second and third floors make up Unit 2 consisting of 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. Freshly painted unit, shiny hardwood floors. Bright and cozy, lots of updates. Come see for yourself! On the main level living room, kitchen, first bedroom and full bath. Stackable washer/dryer in kitchen pantry for convenience. Second bedroom is located upstairs with separate back entrance - perfect set up for room mate situation. Upper level also consists of large walk-in closet and full bath. On site parking lot with 2 reserved spaces. Great commutable location with a short walk to Glenbrook train station. Two minute walk to Julia A. Stark Elementary.
